svg.title: Rung 7's twitch: FlyMimic's tibia flexor with a two-state and a first-order activation, against flies
svg.text: Rung 7's twitch: a calcium-like active state against MuJoCo's first-order activation
FlyMimic's tibia flexor against a fly's force probe, from the motor neuron's spike. Shaded: flies (Azevedo et al. 2020); 120 Hz stands in for flies' unreported burst rate.
The two-state model relaxes and plateaus like a fly's muscle but sums two spikes too strongly; the first-order one fits the twitch and the doublet but not the plateau.

rect.title: flies: half gone 12-16 ms after the peak

svg.text: Two-state: twitch 8.1 uN, peak 18.5 ms, half gone 10.9 ms after it, two spikes 1.823 x one. First-order, 10 ms: 8.27 uN, 16.1 ms, 15.5 ms, 1.597 x.
